title: DevLoopConfig
description: Configuration schema for multi-harness DevLoop orchestration.

objective.description: High-level engineering task or goal to implement.

base_branch.description: Base git branch to branch worktrees from and reconcile into.

worktree_dir.description: Root directory under which worktrees are provisioned.

terminal_layout.description: Terminal session layout manager to launch.

timeout_seconds.description: Execution timeout per lane in seconds.

domain.description: Subsystem domain (e.g., backend, frontend, qa, security).

worker_id.description: Unique identifier for the worker lane.

harness.description: Agent harness CLI executing the worker commands.

worktree.description: Worktree path relative to repository root.

command.description: Primary task command or prompt passed to the harness.

test_cmd.description: Optional validation or test command executed after task completion.

env.description: Optional environment variables injected into the worker process.
